items.name: Manufacturers
items.title: Your factory, on shelves in four new markets.
items.sub: You make well and already export. We take your product into four new markets — approvals, channel and warranty — and stay on after the first container lands.

pains.d: An agent in an office takes the order and the commission. Nobody is in the shop when the third container arrives.
BIS, PSQCA, BPS and UAE approvals each run on their own clock. Start late and the market waits months.
Duty, clearance and freight surprises turn a priced container into a loss.

offer.d: Research and samples in front of real buyers before you commit to a container.
Certification, entity and customs run in parallel, filed by us.
Dealers, shops and marketplaces in every city, with monthly sell-through reports.
Warranty, spares and returns handled locally, so the second shipment is easier than the first.

items.name: Distributors & retailers
items.title: Stock brands with real backing.
items.sub: Brands that arrive certified, priced for your channel and backed by a warranty someone honours.

pains.d: The importer changes, the quality drifts, the next batch arrives late — and your customers blame you.
When the brand will not stand behind the product, returns pile up at your counter.
No training, no display material, no marketing — just a price list.

offer.d: TGO brands and partner brands, priced for general trade, modern trade and marketplaces.
Local replacement and spares, so a claim never becomes your loss.
Retail training packs, display and promotion support with every range.
Stock, orders and dealer accounts in one system, set up by our team.

items.name: Creators
items.title: Your own product line, sold where your audience lives.
items.sub: Brand deals pay once; your own product keeps paying. We develop, make, launch and ship it with you.

pains.d: Your audience trusts you, but every deal is someone else's product and someone else's margin.
Sourcing from China without a team on the ground means samples that drift and timelines that slip.
Ordering too much ties up cash; too little and the launch sells out with nothing behind it.

offer.d: Product research and samples shaped around what your audience actually asks for.
Manufacturing in the Pearl River Delta, with packaging and identity built around you.
Marketplaces, social commerce and retail in your audience's markets.
Freight, warehousing, delivery and warranty handled for you.

items.name: Investors
items.title: Invest in markets you can see into.
items.sub: Emerging-market consumer brands are hard to vet from abroad. Back our brands, trial shipments or distributors — with the stage-by-stage reporting our partners get.

pains.d: Informal trade, cash channels and thin data make these markets difficult to underwrite from a distance.
Capital is easier to find than people who have actually sold in Saddar, Patna and Manila.
Good brands stall waiting for inventory and letters of credit.

offer.d: Co-invest in TGO-owned brands from launch, alongside the founders.
Fund inventory for trial containers, repaid from sell-through.
Back distribution operations in a market we already run.
Stage, shipment and sell-through reporting from the partner portal.
